attribution: The divergence enters through the wrist_camera RGB observation at step 0. The 40 proximity sensors, the exo_camera_1 RGB, qpos and the replayed initial state are all bit-identical, and the safety correction is identically zero in both arms, so neither the residual controller nor the reference pipeline can be the cause. Both rollouts emit the pre-existing MolmoSpaces warning 'Camera sensor wrist_camera observation mismatch between reset and first step. Overwriting cached observation with current state.', which names exactly the divergent stream. A ~2.5e-05 difference in the ACT nominal action at step 0 then amplifies over 200 closed-loop steps into different contact sequences.

control_experiment.conclusion: Two ACT_ONLY rollouts with byte-identical source diverge in exactly the same way as ACT_ONLY versus ACT_PLUS_ZERO: the wrist_camera RGB at step 0 differs while the replayed initial state, the frozen reference skin, the 40 proximity streams, exo_camera_1 and qpos are all bit-identical. Bitwise zero-equivalence is therefore unattainable in this environment for reasons independent of the safety stack, and the earlier annotation-only source edit is excluded as a cause.
control_experiment.design: Two ACT_ONLY rollouts of the same manifest row with byte-identical source, separate processes.

purpose: Root-cause the ACT_ONLY vs ACT_PLUS_ZERO divergence found in the step-10 preflight.

nominal_act_live.verdict: ACT-only succeeds on the preflight row, so NOMINAL_ACT_LIVE_FAILED does not apply
